policy.vcpkg_policy: 本项目生产依赖采用 vendored 源码(third_party/ 与 lib/*/third_party/) 与系统标准库; 不采用 vcpkg 管理。若未来引入 vcpkg, 必须按 vcpkg.json manifest + vcpkg-configuration.json baseline 双重锁定(09/BLD-004 契约), 本锁文件同步记录 vcpkg triplet/baseline commit。
policy.machine_absolute_path_policy: CMake/构建输入不得读取 F:/、C:/Users/<user>、/home/<user> 等机器绝对路径(fresh configure 可复现); Windows 正式工具链安装位置 C:/AstroCS/toolchains/... 为冻结安装约定(09_WINDOWS_TOOLCHAIN_LOCK.md), 由 preset 显式声明, 不属于隐式读取。

production_dependencies.name: cfitsio
production_dependencies.upstream_ref: cfitsio 4.6.4 (ChangeLog 'Version 4.6.4 - Apr 2026', 安全修复版; fitsio.h CFITSIO_VERSION=4.6.4)
production_dependencies.provenance_note: vendored 自仓库引入 commit 5d5be0a (历史迁移); 树内 168 git 追踪文件含 docs/示例; 生产编译集 = cmake/cfitsio_sources.cmake 显式 60 C 源 (BLD-001 禁 GLOB)
production_dependencies.aggregate_sha256_of: sha256(排序后 60 生产源 git-blob-hex 拼接)
production_dependencies.license: NASA/USG 许可 (vendored licenses/License.txt; BLD-003 只读复制至 packaging/licenses/CFITSIO_LICENSE.txt)
production_dependencies.build: STATIC astrocs_cfitsio (根 CMakeLists; SYSTEM 隔离, -w; _REENTRANT; MSVC 需 zlib → ACS_ZLIB_ROOT)

production_dependencies.name: nlohmann-json
production_dependencies.upstream_ref: single header json.hpp v3.12.0 (头内 NLOHMANN_JSON_VERSION 3.12.0)
production_dependencies.build: header-only; 经 -isystem/显式 include 使用

system_dependencies.name: zlib
system_dependencies.policy: Linux: 链接系统 z (astrocs_cfitsio/astrocs_aio/CLI); MSVC: cfitsio zcompress.c 需 zlib → ACS_ZLIB_ROOT cache 变量显式指定(默认空, 不硬编码用户路径); 无 ACS_ZLIB_ROOT 时 cfitsio 降级(不编译 zcompress 路径)
system_dependencies.source: 发行版/用户显式 MSVC 构建 (zlib 1.3.x; BLD-004 不 vendored)

system_dependencies.name: zstd
system_dependencies.policy: aio_compressor.cpp 条件编译 HAS_ZSTD; 未定义时安全 fallback 不压缩; Linux cli/CMakeLists 链接 zstd (遗留 compat); 根产品构建未强制

system_dependencies.name: lz4
system_dependencies.policy: aio_compressor.cpp 条件编译 HAS_LZ4; 未定义时安全 fallback 不压缩

system_dependencies.name: OpenMP
system_dependencies.policy: 仅遗留 target (astrocs_aio/calibration/drizzle) omp pragma 需要; find_package(OpenMP QUIET) UNIX only; 生产不依赖

system_dependencies.name: Threads (pthread)
system_dependencies.policy: find_package(Threads REQUIRED); astrocs_core 依赖; Windows 用 win32_pthread_shim (cmake/win32_pthread_shim, SRWLock 自旋映射, 零 windows.h 依赖)

system_dependencies.name: libm / libdl
system_dependencies.policy: m/z/dl 链接见根 CMakeLists; CMAKE_DL_LIBS

test_only_oracles.name: astropy
test_only_oracles.version: >=5 (控制节点现值 7.x; IO-001 记录 astropy7 兼容)
test_only_oracles.policy: 独立 FITS/WCS oracle (读写交叉/角距), 绝不链接进生产 DLL/EXE

test_only_oracles.name: astrometry.net
test_only_oracles.policy: 非构建依赖; real 数据 WCS oracle 由 Fatduck 侧提供结果 JSON, 控制节点不安装
test_only_oracles.note: 外部求解器 (仅 P* 集成 oracle)
